file_list_assertion: Two paint RAWs selected from three accession-scoped RAWs; procedural blank 2008 excluded. Both selected files appear exactly once.
biological_evidence: Publication Table 1 directly maps museum sample UV1 to LC-MS ID 2009 and UV2 to ID 2010. Both contain bovine collagen attributed to original calfskin hide-glue binder. The organism and skin entries denote inferred binder origin, not a pure single-species sample. Both paint samples also contain modern human saliva proteins; UV1 includes trace plant proteins, so mixed-species nature must be considered when reusing this SDRF. Publication additionally detects bovine beta-casein in UV1 and Bovidae alpha-S1-casein in UV2; their origin cannot be assigned to saliva versus paint production.
technical_evidence: Publication Methods document sequential rLysC and trypsin digestion and Exploris 480 top-10 DDA with 350-1400 m/z MS1, 30 NCE, 1.2 m/z isolation. Both proteases are represented.
limitations: Procedural blank excluded. The SDRF identifies the paint as a mixed matrix. Bos taurus calfskin hide glue is an inferred original binder; human saliva and plant proteins are detected contributions, not asserted original binder ingredients. Animal age, sex and pathology unknown. Casein provenance is unresolved.
